credibility.line: Only one promise can be checked against reported numbers so far — too few to score.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Consolidated revenue growth accelerated strongly, showing reported YoY growth rising from 13.5% in Sep 2025 to 38.8% in Sep 2026.
Consolidated PAT surged 58.9% YoY to 7533.0 crores in Sep 2026, aligning with management claims of profit expansion.
Borrowings doubled over 3 years from INR56,356 crores in Mar 2024 to INR113,129 crores in Sep 2026, despite leverage commitments.

bull: Revenue growth accelerated across four quarters, reaching 38.8% YoY in Sep 2026 with revenue at 91708.0 crores.
EBITDA reached 12814.0 crores in Sep 2026 with an operating margin of 14.0%.
PAT surged 58.9% year-on-year to 7533.0 crores in Sep 2026.
bear: Borrowings surged to INR113,129 crores by Sep 2026 up from INR56,356 crores in Mar 2024.
Free cash flow turned negative at -19508.0 crores for the year ending Mar 2026.
Cash conversion deteriorated with OCF/PAT dropping to 0.77 for the year ending Mar 2026.
